localizedValues.name: Bridge Shelter
localizedValues.description: This site features a covered picnic shelter on a level concrete pad. There are 6 full size picnic tables and two BBQ's. Any outside vendors that are associated with reservations at the shelters are required to have a Discover Pass to enter the park and are required to provide written proof of insurance to the park at least two weeks prior to the date of the event. Such vendors include but are not limited to caterers, equipment providers, etc.

localizedValues.name: Bluff Shelter
localizedValues.description: This site features 6 full size picnic tables on a level concrete pad and 2 BBQ's. This shelter is located along a trail and there is no vehicle traffic allowed. Parking is approximately 300 yards away. This rustic setting has an overview of Puget Sound and is NOT on the beach. Any outside vendors that are associated with reservations at the shelters are required to have a Discover Pass to enter the park and are required to provide written proof of insurance to the park at least two weeks prior to the date of the event. Such vendors include but are not limited to caterers, equipment providers, etc. It is the reservation holder’s responsibility to ensure that vendors are in compliance. All day use shelters must be vacated a half hour before posted closing time. No generators or amplified music without a special activity permit.

localizedValues.name: Creek Shelter
localizedValues.description: The closest Shelter to the beach, it features 6 full size picnic tables on a level concrete pad and a BBQ. This site has a sidewalk to and from the parking lot making it ADA assessable. Almost directly across the parking lot from the rest room and horse shoe pit. Any outside vendors that are associated with reservations at the shelters are required to have a Discover Pass to enter the park and are required to provide written proof of insurance to the park at least two weeks prior to the date of the event. Such vendors include but are not limited to caterers, equipment providers, etc. Please contact the park at (253) 661-4956 if you have questions. It is the reservation holder’s responsibility to ensure that vendors are in compliance. All day use shelters must be vacated a half hour before posted closing time. No generators or amplified music without a special activity permit.

localizedValues.name: Beach Point
localizedValues.description: This area does not have a covered shelter but is popular for memorial services and weddings because of the excellent view of Puget Sound. Featuring 4 full size picnic tables and a small fire ring with 3 concrete benches. Any outside vendors that are associated with reservations at the shelters are required to have a Discover Pass to enter the park and are required to provide written proof of insurance to the park at least two weeks prior to the date of the event. Such vendors include but are not limited to caterers, equipment providers, etc. Please contact the park at (253) 661-4956 if you have questions. It is the reservation holder’s responsibility to ensure that vendors are in compliance. All day use shelters must be vacated a half hour before posted closing time. No generators or amplified music without a special activity permit.

localizedValues.name: CCC Fire Ring
localizedValues.description: This unsheltered area features a large fire place and 10 full size picnic tables. Seating approximately 80 people. This area is approximately 150 feet off the parking lot on an asphalt ADA trail. There is no vehicle traffic allowed on this trail. Excellent view of Puget Sound. Any outside vendors that are associated with reservations at the shelters are required to have a Discover Pass to enter the park and are required to provide written proof of insurance to the park at least two weeks prior to the date of the event. Such vendors include but are not limited to caterers, equipment providers, etc. Please contact the park at (253) 661-4956 if you have questions. It is the reservation holder’s responsibility to ensure that vendors are in compliance. All day use shelters must be vacated a half hour before posted closing time. No generators or amplified music without a special activity permit.
